notes: Rendering works when the app is launched from the Dock or Spotlight, not only from a terminal. ffmpeg was looked up on PATH, which a GUI app does not inherit — the app now finds it in the Homebrew and MacPorts locations directly, with an AURAFORGE_FFMPEG override. The Render MP4 button was being crushed to two pixels by the panel's flex layout because its content is taller than the window; it no longer shrinks, and the action is rebuilt as a proper primary button with its resolution, length, frame rate and estimated size on a second line.
